ms.report:
Milestone 2 – Architecture and API Build Out
I’m pleased to submit Milestone 2 for the AI Trading Insights project. This milestone marks the successful implementation of the core backend system, covering automated data ingestion, LLM-driven token analysis, and a structured API to serve insights. The system is now functionally operational and designed to be flexible, futureproof, and developer-friendly.
Demo Overview
Instead of using a private Google Drive upload, the demo has been published as a public-facing YouTube video. This approach aligns with best practices from previous proposals, promoting transparency, encouraging community feedback, and maximizing impact.
Watch the demonstration video here:
 🔗 https://youtu.be/dL4XNo5C1Tc
The video demonstrates the full end-to-end process. A cron-based batch job automatically fetches top-volume Cardano native tokens, processes OHLCV data, and sends it to the LLM. Gemini 2 Flash Lite, integrated through Google Cloud Platform, processes the data and returns structured insights using a customizable schema. These results are stored in a PostgreSQL database, and a custom-built API retrieves the insights using parameters like limit and includeMeta.
For the demonstration, I utilized the Taptools API to retrieve top-volume tokens and their corresponding OHLC and volume data. This integration provided the necessary real-world data for testing while the system awaits connection to its final consumer-facing data source.
Logs shown in the video confirm each step from ingestion to analysis to API response.

The batch job is created and successfully pulling analysis data on a scheduled basis.
 Database APIs have been implemented and demonstrated through real-time requests returning token analysis from the database.

UI Display and Integration
I’m pleased to submit Milestone 3 for the AI Trading Insights project. This milestone delivers the full frontend integration and visual interface for displaying model-driven analysis of Cardano native assets. The system now connects backend insights to a responsive, interactive user experience, fulfilling the milestone criteria for both UI display and API integration.
Demo Overview
To demonstrate the work completed, I’ve recorded a full walkthrough of the development environment, showing how structured insights are presented visually for various Cardano native tokens. I placed strong emphasis on presentation, ensuring that each insight data point is visualised effectively to help users interpret the information quickly and with confidence.
Watch the demonstration video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wwYgbmr8BEw
Additionally posted on X where the video is much clearer: https://x.com/ItsDave_ADA/status/1938924375253647403
This video highlights:
・The AI Trading Insights UI displaying token-specific analysis
・Dynamic cards with summarised insights including trend direction, momentum, sentiment, and risk/reward
・A radar chart and bubble chart visualising performance metrics and price levels
・Support and resistance zones extracted with weighted confidence
・Real-time rendered outputs from the Gemini Flash Lite 2 and 2.5 integrations
・Responsive layout optimised for desktop and mobile viewing

Implementation Highlights
・Fully responsive interface designed in React with Tailwind CSS, adapting smoothly to screen size
・Real-time integration with backend APIs using TanStack Query for efficient fetching and intelligent caching
・Support for multiple LLM providers (Gemini 2 and 2.5), plugged into a cron-based pipeline
・Schema-driven UI design, capable of ingesting consistent insights from any structured model response
・Componentised architecture allowing rapid iteration and future dashboard extensions

ms.report:
I am excited to submit the final milestone for Cardano AI Asset Insights, a fully functional open source platform that delivers real time AI generated insights for Cardano native assets. The system uses Gemini 2 and 2.5 via Vertex AI to process live token data, providing structured analytics through a REST API and a responsive frontend. All milestones have been completed, with code and documentation publicly available for the Cardano ecosystem.
ADA Markets Integration
As outlined in Milestone 1, this proposal originally aimed to integrate insights into app.ada.markets. Since then, ADA Markets has transitioned under Fetch and is no longer actively maintained. As a result, integration into app.ada.markets is no longer technically feasible and falls outside my control.
However, I approached the original ADA Markets team requesting that we open source the work, given the difficulty in achieving this final milestone as the original acceptance criteria specifically referenced availability on app.ada.markets. They agreed. As part of this milestone, the entire platform, which was originally closed source, has now been released under the MIT License.
By releasing the platform publicly, I believe the intent of the milestone has been fully achieved. While it is not deployed on app.ada.markets specifically, it is now openly available to anyone in the Cardano ecosystem to run, integrate, or build upon. This ensures that the insights engine is not only accessible but also extendable and usable by any project or individual, making it more valuable and future-proof than a single-site deployment.
